title: Hero Enhanced Vanilla
description: QoL mod collection, that I personally like to play with for a better vanilla experience.
body:
![Big Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab481b914169a2b72f44ba5e49bd283f2e36be14.png)

This modpack is a lightweight, performance-focused enhancement pack designed to improve the overall Minecraft experience while preserving the vanilla feel. It includes extensive optimization, visual improvements, quality-of-life features, enhanced accessibility, minimap and world map integration, dynamic lighting, and streamlined inventory management. Carefully selected client and utility mods ensure smoother gameplay, better usability, and improved multiplayer convenience without altering core game progression.
